paragraphs.source_en: On the question of Takatenjin Castle, Tokugawa Ieyasu's prediction was exactly in accord with Oda Nobunaga's thinking.

units.source_en: On the question of Takatenjin Castle, Tokugawa Ieyasu's prediction was exactly in accord with Oda Nobunaga's thinking.
units.source_zh: 在关于高天神城的问题上，德川家康的预测和织田信长的想法如出一辙。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在关于高天神城的问题上，德川家康的预测和织田信长的想法如出一辙。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu was more solemn than Nobunaga. “I cannot thank you enough for coming such a long way despite the hardship.”

units.source_en: Ieyasu was more solemn than Nobunaga. “I cannot thank you enough for coming such a long way despite the hardship.”
units.source_zh: 家康比信长更加严肃：“您不辞辛苦远道而来，我感激不尽。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康比信长更加严肃：“您不辞辛苦远道而来，我感激不尽。”

paragraphs.source_en: The two sides exchanged courtesies for a while. Ieyasu was the first to rise and proposed that Nobunaga withdraw to Yoshida Castle. “I, Ieyasu, ask that you return to Yoshida Castle.”

units.source_en: The two sides exchanged courtesies for a while.
units.source_zh: 双方寒暄了一阵。

units.source_en: Ieyasu was the first to rise and proposed that Nobunaga withdraw to Yoshida Castle. “I, Ieyasu, ask that you return to Yoshida Castle.”
units.source_zh: 家康率先起身，建议信长向吉田城撤退：“家康愿您撤回吉田城。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 双方寒暄了一阵。家康率先起身，建议信长向吉田城撤退：“家康愿您撤回吉田城。”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori had installed Yokota Jingorō in Takatenjin Castle, and his main force was withdrawing. With Nobunaga's reinforcements arriving, they had not dared advance against Hamamatsu. That suited the two commanders, Oda and Tokugawa, who had never intended to fight in the first place.

units.source_en: Katsuyori had installed Yokota Jingorō in Takatenjin Castle, and his main force was withdrawing.
units.source_zh: 胜赖已令横田甚五郎入驻高天神城，其主力正在撤退。

units.source_en: With Nobunaga's reinforcements arriving, they had not dared advance against Hamamatsu.

ja.t: せることができなかった。

units.source_zh: 因为信长援军的到达，他们没敢前去攻打滨松。

units.source_en: That suited the two commanders, Oda and Tokugawa, who had never intended to fight in the first place.
units.source_zh: 正中自始至终不准备打仗的织田和德川两位大将下怀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖已令横田甚五郎入驻高天神城，其主力正在撤退。因为信长援军的到达，他们没敢前去攻打滨松。正中自始至终不准备打仗的织田和德川两位大将下怀。

paragraphs.source_en: After withdrawing to Yoshida Castle, Nobunaga gave Ieyasu all the gold he had brought with him. Having displayed his courage and magnanimity, he leisurely returned to Gifu on the twenty-first. He deliberately refrained from seeing his daughter Tokuhime and his son-in-law Nobuyasu.

units.source_en: After withdrawing to Yoshida Castle, Nobunaga gave Ieyasu all the gold he had brought with him. Having displayed his courage and magnanimity, he leisurely returned to Gifu on the twenty-first.
units.source_zh: 信长撤退至吉田城后，将带过来的黄金一并交给了家康，显示了自己的胆量和气魄后，于二十一日悠然撤回了岐阜。

units.source_en: He deliberately refrained from seeing his daughter Tokuhime and his son-in-law Nobuyasu.
units.source_zh: 他故意没去见女儿德姬和女婿信康。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长撤退至吉田城后，将带过来的黄金一并交给了家康，显示了自己的胆量和气魄后，于二十一日悠然撤回了岐阜。他故意没去见女儿德姬和女婿信康。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōga Yashirō escorted the supremely confident Nobunaga beyond the castle, while his own heart brimmed with a different kind of satisfaction and confidence. Yashirō gave Nobunaga his name, but Nobunaga paid him no attention whatsoever, treating him as though he did not exist.

units.source_en: Ōga Yashirō escorted the supremely confident Nobunaga beyond the castle, while his own heart brimmed with a different kind of satisfaction and confidence.
units.source_zh: 大贺弥四郎将信心十足的信长送到城外，内心却充满另一种满足和自信。

units.source_en: Yashirō gave Nobunaga his name, but Nobunaga paid him no attention whatsoever, treating him as though he did not exist.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎向信长通报了姓名，但信长根本没在意他，对他视若无物。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大贺弥四郎将信心十足的信长送到城外，内心却充满另一种满足和自信。弥四郎向信长通报了姓名，但信长根本没在意他，对他视若无物。

paragraphs.source_en: Though the sun blazed fiercely that day, Yashirō thought it wholly improper for a man of Nobunaga's standing to shed his clothes on horseback. Nobunaga, however, cared nothing for appearances. He galloped his favorite horse toward the Yahagi River, then nonchalantly let it drink. Whether he sensed Yashirō's cold gaze upon his back was impossible to tell. A man like that could never be fit to command, Yashirō thought. Just wait—sooner or later your head will be delivered to Katsuyori.

units.source_en: Though the sun blazed fiercely that day, Yashirō thought it wholly improper for a man of Nobunaga's standing to shed his clothes on horseback.

ja.t: ぐなど、まことにあるまじきことだと

units.source_zh: 这一天虽烈日炎炎，但弥四郎认为信长这种人物，实在不该在马背上脱衣服。

units.source_en: Nobunaga, however, cared nothing for appearances. He galloped his favorite horse toward the Yahagi River, then nonchalantly let it drink.
units.source_zh: 然而信长毫不在意，骑爱马驰向矢矧川，然后大大咧咧让马饮水。

units.source_en: Whether he sensed Yashirō's cold gaze upon his back was impossible to tell.

ja.t: づいていたかどうかはわからない。

units.source_zh: 不知他是否意识到背后弥四郎那阴冷的目光。

units.source_en: A man like that could never be fit to command, Yashirō thought. Just wait—sooner or later your head will be delivered to Katsuyori.

ja.t: ているがよい。いずれその

units.source_zh: 这种人绝非大将之器，弥四郎想，走着瞧吧，你的脑袋早晚会被送到胜赖处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这一天虽烈日炎炎，但弥四郎认为信长这种人物，实在不该在马背上脱衣服。然而信长毫不在意，骑爱马驰向矢矧川，然后大大咧咧让马饮水。不知他是否意识到背后弥四郎那阴冷的目光。这种人绝非大将之器，弥四郎想，走着瞧吧，你的脑袋早晚会被送到胜赖处。

paragraphs.source_en: “All is well between the Tokugawa and Oda houses.” Nobunaga laughed heartily at the retainers who had escorted him to the great Yahagi Bridge, then wheeled his horse around and departed.

units.source_en: “All is well between the Tokugawa and Oda houses.”
units.source_zh: “德川和织田两家相安无事。”

units.source_en: Nobunaga laughed heartily at the retainers who had escorted him to the great Yahagi Bridge, then wheeled his horse around and departed.
units.source_zh: 信长对送他到矢矧大桥的家臣们豪爽地笑道，然后拨转马头去了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “德川和织田两家相安无事。”信长对送他到矢矧大桥的家臣们豪爽地笑道，然后拨转马头去了。

paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō had his own ideas. To his mind, this was the key that would decide his fate. Nobunaga had failed to arrive before Takatenjin Castle fell because of his own cunning and miscalculation. If he had no wish to fight, why had he led a great army all this way?

units.source_en: Yashirō had his own ideas.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎自有想法。

units.source_en: To his mind, this was the key that would decide his fate.
units.source_zh: 在他看来，这是决定他命运的关键。

units.source_en: Nobunaga had failed to arrive before Takatenjin Castle fell because of his own cunning and miscalculation.
units.source_zh: 信长没在高天神城陷落之前赶到，是由于他的狡猾和失算。

units.source_en: If he had no wish to fight, why had he led a great army all this way?
units.source_zh: 既然不愿交战，又为何率领大军远道而来？

paragraphs.source_zh: 弥四郎自有想法。在他看来，这是决定他命运的关键。信长没在高天神城陷落之前赶到，是由于他的狡猾和失算。既然不愿交战，又为何率领大军远道而来？

paragraphs.source_en: Had Nobunaga understood this, he should have hastened to Takatenjin Castle and dealt the Kai army a fatal blow. Yet he had understood nothing; he merely left Ieyasu the gold and withdrew. What could it possibly mean? In truth, when Yashirō first heard that Nobunaga's reinforcements were coming, he had looked up to heaven and groaned, “Disaster!”

units.source_en: Had Nobunaga understood this, he should have hastened to Takatenjin Castle and dealt the Kai army a fatal blow. Yet he had understood nothing; he merely left Ieyasu the gold and withdrew.

ja.t: えるべきだった。ところが

units.source_zh: 如果信长意识到了这一点，他应该及时赶到高天神城，给甲州军以致命的打击，但信长却没认识到，他给家康留下黄金便撤回了。

units.source_en: What could it possibly mean?

ja.t: これはいったい、どういうことなのか。

units.source_zh: 这究竟是怎么回事？

units.source_en: In truth, when Yashirō first heard that Nobunaga's reinforcements were coming, he had looked up to heaven and groaned, “Disaster!”
units.source_zh: 实际上，当弥四郎听到信长援军到来时，曾经仰天长叹：糟！

paragraphs.source_zh: 如果信长意识到了这一点，他应该及时赶到高天神城，给甲州军以致命的打击，但信长却没认识到，他给家康留下黄金便撤回了。这究竟是怎么回事？实际上，当弥四郎听到信长援军到来时，曾经仰天长叹：糟！

paragraphs.source_en: If the Kai army suffered a mortal blow at Takatenjin Castle, every one of Yashirō's dreams would vanish like foam. Born into a family of ashigaru warriors, he would spend the rest of his life as the magistrate of twenty villages. It was utterly inconceivable that he might attack from behind the combined Oda and Tokugawa army marching into Tōtōmi, and so he had been at his wits' end.

units.source_en: If the Kai army suffered a mortal blow at Takatenjin Castle, every one of Yashirō's dreams would vanish like foam.
units.source_zh: 如果甲州军在高天神城遭受致命打击，他弥四郎的所有梦想，都要化为泡影。

units.source_en: Born into a family of ashigaru warriors, he would spend the rest of his life as the magistrate of twenty villages.
units.source_zh: 出身于足轻武士之家的他，只能终老于二十乡的代官位置上。

units.source_en: It was utterly inconceivable that he might attack from behind the combined Oda and Tokugawa army marching into Tōtōmi, and so he had been at his wits' end.

ja.t: にはなすすべがなかった。

units.source_zh: 他根本不可能想到从背后袭击出兵远州的织田与德川联军，因此一筹莫展。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如果甲州军在高天神城遭受致命打击，他弥四郎的所有梦想，都要化为泡影。出身于足轻武士之家的他，只能终老于二十乡的代官位置上。他根本不可能想到从背后袭击出兵远州的织田与德川联军，因此一筹莫展。

paragraphs.source_en: But just as despair had overtaken him, Nobunaga casually withdrew beneath the blazing sun; the Kai army on which his dreams depended had not only captured Takatenjin Castle, but had also taken into its ranks such renowned Tōtōmi warriors as Ogasawara Yohachirō Nagatada. Judged by the outcome, it was surely a victory for the Takeda clan.

units.source_en: But just as despair had overtaken him, Nobunaga casually withdrew beneath the blazing sun;
units.source_zh: 但就在他心灰意懒之际，信长却大咧咧地顶着烈日撤退了；

units.source_en: the Kai army on which his dreams depended had not only captured Takatenjin Castle, but had also taken into its ranks such renowned Tōtōmi warriors as Ogasawara Yohachirō Nagatada.
units.source_zh: 维系着他梦想的甲州军不但攻下了高天神城，而且将闻名远州的小笠原与八郎长忠等猛将收入麾下。

units.source_en: Judged by the outcome, it was surely a victory for the Takeda clan.
units.source_zh: 从结果上看，无论如何，应是武田氏的胜利。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但就在他心灰意懒之际，信长却大咧咧地顶着烈日撤退了；维系着他梦想的甲州军不但攻下了高天神城，而且将闻名远州的小笠原与八郎长忠等猛将收入麾下。从结果上看，无论如何，应是武田氏的胜利。

paragraphs.source_en: Thereafter, the fighting between Takeda and Tokugawa remained deadlocked. In late September, Katsuyori again marched into Tōtōmi and attacked Hamamatsu Castle, but failed to take it. In February of the coming year, Katsuyori would march once more, this time upon Nagashino. At year's end, he therefore sent a secret messenger to Yashirō, asking him to assist from within.

units.source_en: Thereafter, the fighting between Takeda and Tokugawa remained deadlocked. In late September, Katsuyori again marched into Tōtōmi and attacked Hamamatsu Castle, but failed to take it.

ja.t: とすことはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 此后武田与德川战事胶着，至九月末，胜赖再次出兵远州，攻打滨松城，未克。

units.source_en: In February of the coming year, Katsuyori would march once more, this time upon Nagashino.

ja.t: することになっていた。

units.source_zh: 明年二月，胜赖将再次出兵长筱。

units.source_en: At year's end, he therefore sent a secret messenger to Yashirō, asking him to assist from within.
units.source_zh: 他遂于年末派遣密使来弥四郎处要求给予接应。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此后武田与德川战事胶着，至九月末，胜赖再次出兵远州，攻打滨松城，未克。明年二月，胜赖将再次出兵长筱。他遂于年末派遣密使来弥四郎处要求给予接应。

paragraphs.source_en: Had the day finally come? Yashirō laughed in unrestrained delight. He had waited far too long!

units.source_en: Had the day finally come?
units.source_zh: 这天终于到来了吗？

units.source_en: Yashirō laughed in unrestrained delight.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎开怀大笑。

units.source_en: He had waited far too long!
units.source_zh: 他等得太久了！

paragraphs.source_zh: 这天终于到来了吗？弥四郎开怀大笑。他等得太久了！

paragraphs.source_en: The man who delivered the secret letter was someone Yashirō had deliberately stationed in the castle town. For a long while, he could not still the excitement in his heart.

units.source_en: The man who delivered the secret letter was someone Yashirō had deliberately stationed in the castle town.
units.source_zh: 送密函来的，是弥四郎特意安排住在城下的人。

units.source_en: For a long while, he could not still the excitement in his heart.
units.source_zh: 他内心久久无法平静。

paragraphs.source_zh: 送密函来的，是弥四郎特意安排住在城下的人。他内心久久无法平静。

paragraphs.source_en: First, he would visit Lady Tsukiyama. Yashirō left his residence, treading upon the hard frost, but then reconsidered and headed instead for Nobuyasu's chamber in the main castle. Did Nobuyasu know of the coming battle that would decide their fate?

units.source_en: First, he would visit Lady Tsukiyama.
units.source_zh: 还是先拜访筑山夫人吧。

units.source_en: Yashirō left his residence, treading upon the hard frost, but then reconsidered and headed instead for Nobuyasu's chamber in the main castle.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎踏着严霜出了府邸，但转念一想，又走向本城信康的卧房。

units.source_en: Did Nobuyasu know of the coming battle that would decide their fate?
units.source_zh: 信康是否知道接下来那场决定命运的一战？

paragraphs.source_zh: 还是先拜访筑山夫人吧。弥四郎踏着严霜出了府邸，但转念一想，又走向本城信康的卧房。信康是否知道接下来那场决定命运的一战？

paragraphs.source_en: For caution's sake, Yashirō decided to sound out Nobuyasu first. It was a lesson he had learned over many years.

units.source_en: For caution's sake, Yashirō decided to sound out Nobuyasu first. It was a lesson he had learned over many years.
units.source_zh: 为慎重起见，弥四郎想先到信康处打探，这也是他多年的心得。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为慎重起见，弥四郎想先到信康处打探，这也是他多年的心得。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuyasu was discussing the war with four guards in his chamber. Delighted to see Yashirō, he invited him inside and asked, “What do you make of Ōkōchi Genzaburō of Takatenjin Castle?”

units.source_en: Nobuyasu was discussing the war with four guards in his chamber. Delighted to see Yashirō, he invited him inside and asked, “What do you make of Ōkōchi Genzaburō of Takatenjin Castle?”
units.source_zh: 信康正和四名侍卫在房内谈论战事，见到弥四郎，高兴地让他进屋，问道：“对于高天神城的大河内源三郎，你有何看法？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信康正和四名侍卫在房内谈论战事，见到弥四郎，高兴地让他进屋，问道：“对于高天神城的大河内源三郎，你有何看法？”

paragraphs.source_en: “In my humble opinion, Ōkōchi Genzaburō is a true warrior who understands both loyalty and honor.”

units.source_en: “In my humble opinion, Ōkōchi Genzaburō is a true warrior who understands both loyalty and honor.”
units.source_zh: “在下觉得，大河内源三郎是知情知义的真武士。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下觉得，大河内源三郎是知情知义的真武士。”

paragraphs.source_en: At those words, Yashirō nearly burst out laughing. It was absurd enough that Nobuyasu should now be discussing the fall of Takatenjin Castle, already a thing of the past; more comical still were the dejected faces of Hiraiwa Chikayoshi, Nonaka Shigemasa, Kondō Iki, and the others.

units.source_en: At those words, Yashirō nearly burst out laughing.
units.source_zh: 听到这话，弥四郎差点笑出声。

units.source_en: It was absurd enough that Nobuyasu should now be discussing the fall of Takatenjin Castle, already a thing of the past; more comical still were the dejected faces of Hiraiwa Chikayoshi, Nonaka Shigemasa, Kondō Iki, and the others.
units.source_zh: 信康现在谈论已成过去的高天神城陷落一事，本就显得十分可笑，更滑稽的是平岩亲吉、野中重政和近藤一岐等人那副失落的表情。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到这话，弥四郎差点笑出声。信康现在谈论已成过去的高天神城陷落一事，本就显得十分可笑，更滑稽的是平岩亲吉、野中重政和近藤一岐等人那副失落的表情。

paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō knew Nobuyasu's character and abilities very well. In his eyes, Nobuyasu was childish and ridiculous. Imprisoned though he was, Ōkōchi Genzaburō surely still believed that Ieyasu would retake Takatenjin Castle, and so had vowed to die rather than defect. He deserved Nobuyasu's praise, yet, unexpectedly, Nobuyasu criticized Genzaburō as inferior to others.

units.source_en: Yashirō knew Nobuyasu's character and abilities very well.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎很清楚信康的为人和能力。

units.source_en: In his eyes, Nobuyasu was childish and ridiculous.
units.source_zh: 在他眼中，信康实幼稚可笑。

units.source_en: Imprisoned though he was, Ōkōchi Genzaburō surely still believed that Ieyasu would retake Takatenjin Castle, and so had vowed to die rather than defect. He deserved Nobuyasu's praise, yet, unexpectedly, Nobuyasu criticized Genzaburō as inferior to others.
units.source_zh: 身陷囹圄的大河内源三郎定还坚信家康会夺回高天神城，因此誓死不变节，应该受到信康的褒奖，不想信康竟批评源三郎不如他人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 弥四郎很清楚信康的为人和能力。在他眼中，信康实幼稚可笑。身陷囹圄的大河内源三郎定还坚信家康会夺回高天神城，因此誓死不变节，应该受到信康的褒奖，不想信康竟批评源三郎不如他人。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ōga?” Nobuyasu turned to Yashirō. “Only by returning alive can a man continue to serve his lord. Do you not think it would be wiser to feign defection, contrive an escape from prison, and return to Hamamatsu?”

units.source_en: “Ōga?”
units.source_zh: “大贺？”

units.source_en: Nobuyasu turned to Yashirō. “Only by returning alive can a man continue to serve his lord.
units.source_zh: 信康转向弥四郎，“只有活着回来，才能继续为主人效劳。

units.source_en: Do you not think it would be wiser to feign defection, contrive an escape from prison, and return to Hamamatsu?”
units.source_zh: 你不认为假装变节，混出牢房后回滨松来，才是上策吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大贺？”信康转向弥四郎，“只有活着回来，才能继续为主人效劳。你不认为假装变节，混出牢房后回滨松来，才是上策吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō was startled. “No, that is not what I think.” Concealing his inner disquiet, he smiled calmly.

units.source_en: Yashirō was startled.
units.source_zh: 弥四郎吃了一惊。

units.source_en: “No, that is not what I think.”
units.source_zh: “不，在下不这样想。”
